widgets_values:
⚠️ ВНИМАНИЕ! ПРОЧТИ МЕНЯ! / READ ME! ⚠️
⚡ Neron H3 Engine Fast — тестовая версия (dev) / test build (dev)
Цель: 10 с видео в максимальном размере модели (1344×768) — быстро и без «мыла».
Goal: 10 s at the model's max size (1344×768) — fast and without blur.
Описание — кнопка 📖 Help / Справка на ноде. После прогона на ноде появляется 📋 Отчёт — присылай его вместе с видео.
Help — 📖 button on the node. After a run the node shows a 📋 Report — send it with the video.

==================================================
📦 НОДЫ / CUSTOM NODES
==================================================
• Neron pack — https://github.com/neron5480-cell/neron-video-minimax-h3-i2v (Manager → Install via Git URL)
• Comfyroll (CR Prompt Text) — https://github.com/Suzie1/ComfyUI_Comfyroll_CustomNodes
Свой промпт можно заменить Neron AutoPrompter: minimax_prompt → prompt, img_0 → first_frame.
You can swap the prompt for Neron AutoPrompter: minimax_prompt → prompt, img_0 → first_frame.

==================================================
⚡ ЧЕРНОВИК / DRAFT → models/diffusion_models
==================================================
• Fast H3, 8 шагов / 8 steps (если нет — нода возьмёт базовую модель + турбо-LoRA / if missing — base model + turbo LoRA):
https://huggingface.co/FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-Comfy/resolve/main/diffusion_models/fastvideo_fasth3_8step_v2_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors

==================================================
🧠 ЧИСТОВИК / REFINE → models/diffusion_models
==================================================
• Базовая модель / base model, int8:
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors

==================================================
🎛 LoRA → models/loras
==================================================
• Taomate 3-step (minimax_h3_taomate_fl2va_3step_ema_comfyui) — для чистовика, если есть / for the refine, if you have it.
• Иначе наша турбо-LoRA / otherwise our turbo LoRA:
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_768p_comfyui_bf16.safetensors

==================================================
🔍 АПСКЕЙЛЕР / UPSCALER → models/latent_upscale_models (необязательно / optional)
==================================================
Модель увеличения латента H3. Нет или не подошла — нода растянет латент сама (отчёт скажет).
An H3 latent upscale model. Missing or not compatible — the node stretches the latent itself (the report says so).

==================================================
📝 ТЕКСТ И VAE / TEXT ENCODER & VAE
==================================================
• models/text_encoders: https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
• models/vae (видео — лучше fp16 / video — fp16 is better):
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
